text.en:
ARMS AND EXPLOSIVES ACT (CHAPTER 58)

DELEGATION OF POWERS GN 225/00

REVISED EDITION 2002 (30th November 2002)

LAWS OF BRUNEI CAP. 58, N 1] Arms and Explosives [2002 Ed. p. 1 [Subsidiary]

SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION

ARMS AND EXPLOSIVES RULES

DELEGATION OF POWERS In exercise of the power conferred by rule 14 of the Arms and Explosives Rules, the Prime Minister hereby delegates to the Commissioner of Police the exercise of his power (in his capacity as Licensing Officer), to sign licences issued under the Arms and Explosives Rules which have been approved by the Licensing Officer under those Rules.
